# One bank entry that both takes Alpha's advance in and sends a vendor's
# prepayment out, netting 50.00 through the bank. Alpha's advance has already
# been divided: 40.00 of it settled a document — so that half arrives loose,
# the export writing no `lot_owner:` for a split in a document's lot — and
# 60.00 is left as credit.
#
# Two credit lots sit beside the loose half, on two different accounts, naming
# two different owners. Neither can be said to be the credit the loose half
# came out of, so the book cannot say whose that half is and does not guess.
customer "C-TWO-A"
	name: "Alpha"
	currency: CAD

customer "C-TWO-B"
	name: "Beta"
	currency: CAD

vendor "V-TWO"
	name: "Gamma Supply"
	currency: CAD

2026-05-15 * "Alpha pays ahead, the vendor is prepaid"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank 50.00 CAD
	Assets:Accounts Receivable -40.00 CAD
		applied_from_credit: "true"
	Assets:Accounts Receivable -60.00 CAD
		lot_owner: "customer:C-TWO-A"
	Liabilities:Accounts Payable 50.00 CAD
		lot_owner: "vendor:V-TWO"
